Bathroom Remodeling FAQ

How long does a bathroom remodel usually take?

The schedule depends on demolition, plumbing changes, waterproofing, tile, inspections, material availability and the final scope.

Can you convert a tub into a walk-in shower?

Yes. Tub-to-shower conversions can include plumbing changes, slope preparation, waterproofing, tile, glass and accessibility improvements.
